Use the public estimator with boundary subtotals, each delivery tier, valid and invalid promo codes, and narrow or keyboard-focused layouts. Report every displayed subtotal, discount, shipping charge, order total, validation message, and readability issue.

scored.why: The findings do not report a discount amount being larger than the stated percentage of the subtotal or otherwise show shipping included in the discount calculation base.
The run explicitly reports that at exact free-shipping thresholds, tiers are labeled FREE while the shipping row and order total still charge shipping, for both Express ($150) and Standard ($50).
The run explicitly reports that applying an invalid promo after SAVE10 shows an invalid-code error while retaining the prior SAVE10 applied state and discounted total.
